title: Veggie fried rice
description: A quick stir-fried rice with eggs, carrots, peas, and green onions, seasoned with soy sauce and sesame oil.
instructions: Dice the carrot and bell pepper, mince the garlic, and slice the green onions.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat.
Beat the eggs, scramble them in the pan until just set, then move them to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, then cook the carrot and bell pepper for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Add the garlic and peas and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cold rice and break up any clumps. Stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until heated through.
Stir in the soy sauce, sesame oil, and black pepper.
Return the eggs to the pan, add most of the green onions, and toss everything together.
Serve hot, topped with the remaining green onions.
